preamble: Editorial still-life photography on a seamless warm off-white cyclorama. Large soft overhead source, huge white bounce, near-shadowless with one soft contact shadow. High key, gentle contrast, warm white and pale neutral grade. Medium-format sharpness, fine grain. Photographic realism, no CGI, no text, no logos, no watermark.

images.scene: A very large, lush, generous hand-tied bouquet of vividly coloured flowers: deep magenta and blush-pink peonies, coral garden roses, apricot ranunculus and fresh green eucalyptus, wrapped in pale ivory paper, standing upright on a light wooden table in a bright florist studio, seen straight on at table height. Soft daylight from a large window on the right, warm gentle highlights on the petals; the flowers themselves in rich, saturated, lively colour. The bouquet fills the right half of the frame from the table almost to the top edge; the left half of the frame is a clean, empty, softly lit warm off-white wall for text. No people, no hands, no text, no card, no lettering on the paper, no vases or shelves in the background, no logos, no watermark.

Portrait framing of the same bouquet as the reference image: the same deep magenta and blush-pink peonies, coral garden roses, apricot ranunculus and fresh green eucalyptus in pale ivory paper on a light wooden table, the same bright studio, the same soft window daylight and the same rich saturated colours. The bouquet sits in the lower half of the frame and fills it from edge to edge; the upper half of the frame is an empty, softly lit warm off-white wall for text. No people, no hands, no text, no lettering, no logos.

One single deep magenta-pink peony head, fully open, in rich saturated colour, filling the lower two thirds of the frame, soft daylight revealing the layered petal texture, the green stem going straight down out of the frame.
